Travelers provides APIs for business insurance claim reporting, commercial lines quoting, and policy management. These APIs enable agents, brokers, and commercial clients to programmatically manage insurance workflows including submitting claims, obtaining quotes, and managing policies across property, casualty, workers compensation, and commercial auto lines.
